question: footway roads geojson export
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' LIMIT 10

question: residential roads wkt preview
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_AsText(geometry) AS wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' AND names.primary IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10

question: service roads center lon lat
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometry)) AS lon, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)) AS lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'service' LIMIT 10

question: tertiary roads length km rounded
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_Length(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true)) / 1000, 2) AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'tertiary' LIMIT 10

question: secondary roads formatted labels
sql: SELECT printf('%s [%s]', COALESCE(names.primary, 'unnamed'), class) AS label FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'secondary' LIMIT 10

question: steps roads start end coords rounded 5 decimals
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_X(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 5) AS start_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 5) AS start_lat, ROUND(ST_X(ST_EndPoint(geometry)), 5) AS end_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_EndPoint(geometry)), 5) AS end_lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'steps' LIMIT 10
